milestones.title: Observe
milestones.body: Review uptime and investigate unusual readings weekly.

slides.title: Availability improved through the pilot
slides.interpretation: Uptime measures device availability; it does not establish measurement accuracy.

slides.title: The budget protects both coverage and review
slides.interpretation: Analysis funding is reserved before installation begins.

slides.title: Depth now or breadth before the evidence is ready?
slides.verdict: Run the focused pilot; expand only after the coverage and quality review.
